subject: Renewal forecast: Cobalt Health - commit alignment & churn mitigation plan
messages:
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Priya Sharma <priya@cobalthealth.com>, Cobalt Health Finance <finance@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal forecast: Cobalt Health - commit alignment & churn mitigation plan

Hi Priya —

Following up on our Q3 planning calendar: Cobalt’s renewal window opens in mid‑September and the current forecast in HubSpot still shows 60% probability with a $480k ARR commit. Before we lock numbers for the finance forecast, we need three quick confirmations so we can operationalize a targeted retention play: 

1) Can you confirm whether the 5 pilot sites will convert to production by 9/15? Any blockers (procurement, security, budget) we should log now?
2) Please confirm the internal approver name and the planned renewal approver timeline (month/week).
3) If there is any risk of downscoping (fewer seats/features), can you flag expected delta sizing now so we can model ARR impact?

We attached a short commit matrix and a commsheet that helps us align on dates and mutual action items. If you prefer, we can do a 30‑minute renewal health call this week to align stakeholders — Rafael + Marissa + Naomi will join from our side.

Aim: update HubSpot stage + probability by EOD Friday 7/21 so finance can include a revised figure in next week’s forecast pull.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142

Attachments: Cobalt_Renewal_Commsheet_Q3-2028.xlsx, commit_matrix_cobalt.csv
From: Priya Sharma <priya@cobalthealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Cobalt Health Finance <finance@cobalthealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-19T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal forecast: Cobalt Health - commit alignment & churn mitigation plan

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear ask. Quick updates from our side: 

- Pilot conversion is delayed: two sites hit a compliance verification backlog. Estimated conversion now looks like late September (around 9/28) unless we get a prioritized exception.
- Approver is still the same (Neha Patel, Head of Ops); procurement has signaled a possible Q4 reallocation if our spend forecast isn’t tightened.
- There is a potential downscope option under consideration (reducing seat count by ~20% for Q4) — finance wants a delta number before committing.

Can we do a call Thursday 7/20 at 11:00 PT to walk through the commit matrix and a phased rollout option? If Redwood can provide a short phased pricing sketch (impact of 20% seat reduction), that will help move procurement.

—Priya
Director, Digital Operations | Cobalt Health
priya@cobalthealth.com

Rafael / team — thanks for the context. Copying the internal action list so finance and ops can move quickly: 

Action items (internal only):
- Rafael: Confirm call with Priya for Thu 7/20 11:00 PT — capture attendee list and objective (mutual action plan / phased pricing).
- Marissa (me): Prepare a 2‑slide phased pricing sketch showing 0%, 10%, 20% seat reduction impact and an ARR delta table — will attach commit_matrix_cobalt.csv update by EOD 7/20.
- Ben: Mark finance forecast with a conservative adjustment: FH forecast should treat this deal as 40% probability for the 7/31 pull, with a scenario line for 20% seat reduction. Please include ARR delta columns in the feed.
- Naomi: Log potential billing cadence change and confirm whether we can offer a 30‑day procurement grace (billing hold) to reduce churn risk; flag any margin impact.

Notes: Please do not update HubSpot stage to 'Closed‑Won' yet — we should move to 'Commit — At Risk' and add the new mutual action plan link. I patched the commit_matrix and uploaded to the shared drive (link in metadata).

Quoted for context:
> "Pilot conversion is delayed: two sites hit a compliance verification backlog..." — Priya

I will also prepare a short email template Rafael can use with Priya’s approver (Neha) if we need to accelerate exception requests.

Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.com

Priya — great, thanks for the quick reply and for proposing Thursday. 11:00 PT works for our team; invite sent. Agenda: 1) walkthrough updated commit_matrix, 2) phased pricing sketch and delta, 3) procurement path and exception checklist.

Marissa is preparing the pricing sketch and Ben/Naomi will be ready to outline constrained forecast treatment and billing options. Rafael will also bring a short list of low‑friction mitigations we can offer (30‑day billing hold, provisional go‑live acceptance checklist) to reduce the risk of a Q4 reallocation.

We will capture outcomes in HubSpot immediately after the call and update the probability/stage per Marissa/Ben recommendation. Thanks — see you Thursday.

Best,
